title: rosa × dumetorum subvar. cinerosa
intro: Rosa × dumetorum subvar. cinerosa, commonly known as Cinereous Rose or Wild Rose, is a subvariety of the Rosa × dumetorum, a hybrid rose species. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Rosa × dumetorum subvar. cinerosa include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which exhibit sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-cancer properties.
